stories.summary: امریکی صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ نے نیویارک پوسٹ کو دیے گئے ایک انٹرویو میں خبردار کیا ہے کہ اگر آنے والے وسط مدتی انتخابات میں ری پبلکن پارٹی کو شکست ہوئی اور مخالف جماعت ڈیموکریٹس نے کانگریس کے ایوانوں میں اکثریت حاصل کرلی، تو وہ خود کو مسٹر ویٹو بنادیں گے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ اس صورت میں وہ ڈیموکریٹس کے پیش کردہ تمام بلز کو مکمل طور پر مسترد کر دیں گے تاکہ ان کے ایجنڈے کو آگے بڑھنے سے روکا جا سکے۔ صدر کا ماننا ہے کہ مسلسل ویٹو کیے جانے کی وجہ سے مخالف جماعت کا وقت ضائع ہوگا اور آخرکار وہ ایک یا دو ماہ بعد مسائل کے حل اور معاملات طے کرنے کے لیے خود مذاکرات کی میز پر آنے پر مجبور ہوجائیں گے۔ امریکی آئین کے قوانین کے مطابق، ملک کا صدر کانگریس کی طرف سے منظور کردہ کسی بھی قانون کو ویٹو کرنے کا اختیار رکھتا ہے، تاہم دونوں ایوانوں میں دو تہائی ارکان کی بھاری حمایت حاصل ہونے پر صدارتی ویٹو کو منسوخ بھی کیا جا سکتا ہے۔ ماضی میں بھی قانون سازی کے عمل میں دونوں اہم جماعتوں کے درمیان روایتی طور پر سمجھوتے طے پاتے رہے ہیں۔ موجودہ صدر نے اس امید کا اظہار کیا ہے کہ ان کی اپنی جماعت ری پبلکن اس انتخابی معرکے میں فتح یاب ہوگی تاکہ انہیں اس دفاعی حکمت عملی کا سہارا لینے کی ضرورت ہی پیش نہ آئے۔ وہ اپنی صدارت کی دوسری مدت کے دوران اب تک دو بار اور پہلی مدت کے دوران کل دس مرتبہ اپنے اس صدارتی ویٹو کے اختیار کو استعمال کر چکے ہیں۔ امریکا بھر میں یہ اہم وسط مدتی انتخابات آئندہ تین نومبر کو منعقد ہونے جا رہے ہیں، جن میں ایوان نمائندگان کی تمام چار سو پینتیس اور سینیٹ کی کل ایک سو میں سے چونتیس نشستوں کے لیے پولنگ ہوگی۔ ان انتخابات میں ڈیموکریٹس کے لیے ایوان نمائندگان میں اکثریت حاصل کرنے کی خاطر محض تین مزید نشستیں جیتنا لازمی قرار دیا گیا ہے۔ اس پورے عمل کا مقصد یہ یقینی بنانا ہے کہ حکومتی ایجنڈے پر عمل درآمد میں طاقت کا توازن برقرار رہے اور سیاسی محاذ آرائی کے دوران قانونی فیصلوں میں توازن کی راہ نکالی جاسکے۔

stories.title: Ukrainian Air Raid App Hacked to Display False Nuclear Alerts
stories.summary:
Ukrainian military officials reported that the nation's official public air raid notification application experienced a cyberattack. For a brief duration, the platform displayed erroneous warnings indicating that Kyiv and other regions faced imminent nuclear and chemical dangers, alongside warnings regarding potential street battles and the alleged deployment of Russia’s hypersonic Oreshnik missile.

The Ukrainian Air Force released a statement via Telegram confirming the unauthorized digital interference, urging citizens to remain composed and reassuring the public that no actual radiation hazard existed. Meanwhile, the Ministry for Digital Transformation stated that the affected software was taken offline, though alternative warning systems and traditional air raid sirens continued to operate normally.

In a parallel digital security event occurring around the same time, the mobile application belonging to the Russian emergencies ministry suffered a severe cyber assault. According to the state news agency TASS, that breach similarly distributed incorrect notifications to the local population early Monday morning.

At the time of the reports, officials had not determined whether the cyber operations targeting the Ukrainian and Russian warning applications were connected. Both incidents highlighted the ongoing vulnerability of critical public infrastructure and emergency communication networks to hostile digital interference amid ongoing conflicts.

stories.title: ثانیہ مرزا اور شعیب ملک کی بیٹے کی آٹھویں سالگرہ پر نیک تمناؤں کا اظہار
stories.summary: سابق بھارتی ٹینس سٹار ثانیہ مرزا اور پاکستان کرکٹ ٹیم کے سابق کپتان شعیب ملک نے اپنے صاحبزادے اذہان مرزا ملک کی آٹھویں سالگرہ کے پرمسرت موقع پر سوشل میڈیا اکاؤنٹس کے ذریعے اپنے بیٹے کے لیے محبت بھرے پیغامات شیئر کیے ہیں۔ ثانیہ مرزا نے اس خاص دن کی مناسبت سے تصاویر جاری کرتے ہوئے اپنے بیٹے کے ساتھ ہونے پر گہری خوشی کا اظہار کیا۔ دوسری جانب، شعیب ملک نے بھی دو روز بعد ایک مختصر مگر محبت بھرا پیغام جاری کرتے ہوئے بیٹے کو سالگرہ کی مبارکباد دی اور لکھا کہ تم سے محبت ہے۔ ان دونوں کی شادی سن 2010 میں انجام پائی تھی اور اکتوبر 2018 میں ان کے ہاں اس بیٹے کی پیدائش ہوئی تھی۔ تاہم دونوں نے باضابطہ طور پر سال 2024 میں اپنی علیحدگی کا اعلان کردیا تھا، اور اسی سال جنوری میں شعیب ملک نے پاکستانی اداکارہ ثنا جاوید سے دوسری شادی کرلی تھی۔ باہمی علیحدگی کے بعد بھی یہ دونوں والدین اپنے بیٹے کی زندگی کے تمام اہم مواقع پر سوشل میڈیا کے ذریعے خوشگوار لمحات عوام کے ساتھ سانجھا کرتے رہتے ہیں۔ پیشہ ورانہ پس منظر کے لحاظ سے، ثانیہ مرزا نے سال 2023 میں پروفیشنل ٹینس کے کھیل کو خیرباد کہہ دیا تھا، جو اپنے کیریئر میں چھ گرینڈ سلم ٹائٹلز جیتنے کے ساتھ ساتھ سن 2015 میں خواتین کی ڈبلز عالمی رینکنگ میں پہلے نمبر پر بھی قابض رہی تھیں۔ جبکہ شعیب ملک نے دو دہائیوں سے زائد عرصے پر محیط اپنے طویل کرکٹ کیریئر میں پاکستان کی طرف سے پینتیس ٹیسٹ، دو سو ستاسی ون ڈے اور ایک سو چوبیس ٹی ٹوئنٹی بین الاقوامی میچز کھیل کر ملک کا نام روشن کیا۔ اس جوڑے کی علیحدگی کے باوجود بیٹے کی سالگرہ پر ان کی طرف سے پیغامات کا اشتراک مداحوں کی توجہ کا مرکز بنا رہا۔

stories.title: Sindh Chief Minister Inaugurates Rs250 Million Food Walk in Karachi
stories.summary:
Sindh Chief Minister Syed Murad Ali Shah inaugurated the Sindhi Muslim Food Walk in Chanesar Town on Sunday. The Rs250 million urban improvement project was completed through the town administration's own resources, which the chief minister praised as an example of effective financial management and planning by local government institutions. Executed by TMC Chanesar Town, the project began on February 1, 2026, and finished in October 2026. It features overhauled sewerage lines, underground electrical cabling, removed overhead wires, repaired roads and footpaths, new streetlights, decorative lighting, landscaping, updated parking, and fresh traffic signs.

During the inauguration ceremony, the chief minister urged other town administrations to replicate the project by boosting their own revenue generation and efficiently using financial resources. He noted that Karachi holds immense potential for cultural and food tourism, and such initiatives help generate economic activity, attract private investment, and create jobs. He directed the local administration to maintain proper standards for cleanliness, waste management, plantation, and traffic control. Furthermore, he highlighted broader provincial development efforts, noting that the government has doubled OZT grants for Town Municipal Corporations and Union Committees and devolved the Urban Immovable Property Tax to support local bodies.

Addressing wider municipal and security concerns, Mr Shah mentioned that work on 165 roads across Karachi will soon commence alongside major infrastructure initiatives like the Shahrah-i-Bhutto Expressway, K-IV Water Supply Project, and various BRT lines. He also discussed the ongoing rehabilitation of public spaces, parks, and upcoming food streets on Tipu Sultan Road and Burns Road. In a lighthearted remark, he poked fun at media coverage surrounding electricity poles, noting that attention toward obstructing poles has helped resolve public difficulties. He additionally directed the Inspector General of Police Sindh to ensure strong security at the food walk and emphasized that public weapon displays should be avoided to prevent citizen fear.

In a separate meeting in Karachi, Chief Minister Shah and World Bank Country Director Bolormaa Amgaabazar reviewed progress on $3.85 billion worth of development projects funded by the bank across the province. Both officials reaffirmed their dedication to finishing these schemes on time. The ongoing collaboration reflects the provincial government's broader agenda to modernize infrastructure, strengthen local governance, and stimulate economic growth throughout Sindh with international backing.

stories.title: Michigan Democrat Haley Stevens Endorses Republican Mike Rogers in Tight US Senate Race
stories.summary:
US Representative Haley Stevens, a Michigan Democrat, publicly endorsed Republican Mike Rogers on Sunday, providing an unexpected boost to the Republican Party ahead of midterm elections that will determine control of Congress. Stevens, who lost the Democratic Senate primary to Abdul El-Sayed in a competitive race, appeared with Rogers at a Detroit church. The endorsement threatens to deepen divisions within the Democratic Party in a battleground state essential for Democratic hopes of reclaiming the US Senate. Stevens stated she did not belong in El-Sayed's campaign, while President Donald Trump later invited her to join the Republican Party during an Iowa rally.

The unexpected move followed the unraveling of a planned joint appearance between Stevens and El-Sayed. The event fell apart after Stevens called on El-Sayed to condemn an outside group's ad that she argued blamed Israel for high grocery prices, describing the ad as painful. El-Sayed's campaign had previously asked Stevens to skip his events to avoid distractions. Following the endorsement, Republicans praised Stevens for political courage, while Trump repeated unproven claims regarding the Democratic nominee. Conversely, El-Sayed's campaign experienced a surge in fundraising, collecting $1.2 million in the four hours following the announcement. Polls indicated El-Sayed maintained a lead over Rogers, though the endorsement resulted in several of Stevens' congressional staff resigning and drew criticism from local voters.

Concurrently, the midterm elections involve contests for all 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats, with narrow Republican majorities currently holding both chambers. Democrats are favored to win the House while engaging in a tight contest for the Senate, where outcomes in states like Michigan and Alaska remain pivotal. In Alaska, a federal judge dismissed a Justice Department lawsuit that sought to block the certification of results if Republican incumbent Senator Dan S. Sullivan narrowly loses. The lawsuit stemmed from controversy over a challenger named Daniel J. Sullivan Jr appearing on the ballot, whom the incumbent's camp alleged was recruited as a spoiler by the campaign of Democrat Mary Peltola. Peltola and Sullivan Jr have both denied coordination, and the incumbent senator stated he would accept the final election results.

stories.title: Oil Refineries Absorb Rs15 Billion Burden to Lower Petrol Prices
stories.summary:
The federal government announced that domestic oil refineries will absorb a monthly financial burden of Rs15 billion to shield consumers from surging global fuel costs amid the US-Israeli conflict involving Iran. Federal Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik and Information Minister Attaullah Tarar revealed the measure during a joint press conference in Islamabad on Monday.

Malik explained that the arrangement prevented a scheduled Rs15 increase in petrol prices, allowing the commodity to remain cheaper than current international rates. Refineries agreed to ramp up throughput and forego immediate gains, with Malik noting that their recent three-month profits exceeded last year's total annual earnings. The government also revised pricing mechanisms to utilize historical pre-war margins for calculating ex-refinery costs.

During the briefing, officials addressed broader regional disruptions affecting energy logistics and procurement. Malik disclosed that a Pakistan-bound liquefied natural gas (LNG) carrier, identified as the Al Mayeda, was attacked prior to entering the Strait of Hormuz. Qatar and Saudi Arabia strongly condemned the incident as a threat to global energy security, while Qatari authorities launched investigations.

Tarar confirmed that the Prime Minister's Fuel Relief Scheme for motorcyclists and car owners will proceed, with Rs27 billion already distributed among 15 million registered beneficiaries. Officials urged the public to avoid speculation surrounding the vessel attack while monitoring supply stability.

stories.title: مظفر گڑھ میں چار سال سے بند واحد سرکاری اسکول دوبارہ کھل گیا
stories.summary:
پنجاب کے ضلع مظفر گڑھ کے علاقے بستی ساون والا میں چار سال سے بند رہنے والا واحد سرکاری اسکول محکمۂ تعلیم کے احکامات پر کھول دیا گیا ہے۔ صوبائی محکمۂ تعلیم کے مطابق یہ اسکول اساتذہ کی عارضی ایڈجسمنٹ کے ذریعے فعال کیا گیا ہے تاکہ مقامی بچوں کی تعلیم کا سلسلہ شروع ہو سکے۔

اسکول کے کھلنے کے بعد علاقے کے ابتدائی طور پر 19 بچوں نے اس میں داخلہ لے لیا ہے جو کہ اس پسماندہ علاقے کے تعلیمی مستقبل کے لیے ایک اہم قدم ہے۔ تاہم اہلِ علاقہ نے بنیادی سہولیات کی عدم دستیابی پر تشویش کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے بتایا ہے کہ اسکول کی عمارت میں اب تک بجلی، پینے کا صاف پانی اور فرنیچر میسر نہیں ہے۔

اس اقدام سے مقامی والدین میں خوشی کی لہر دوڑ گئی ہے کیونکہ طویل عرصے سے اسکول بند ہونے کی وجہ سے بچوں کو دور دراز علاقوں کا رخ کرنا پڑتا تھا یا ان کی تعلیم رکی ہوئی تھی۔ اب جب کہ اسکول کھول دیا گیا ہے، مقامی افراد نے حکومت سے مطالبہ کیا ہے کہ وہ فوری طور پر وہاں بجلی، پانی اور بیٹھنے کا سامان فراہم کرے تاکہ بچوں کو مشکلات کا سامنا نہ کرناپڑے۔

محکمۂ تعلیم کے اس عارضی اقدام کو عوامی سطح پر سراہا گیا ہے لیکن اسکول کی حالت بہتر بنانے کے لیے مزید حکومتی اقدامات کی ضرورت ہے۔ اسکول کے فعال ہونے سے بستی ساون والا کے بچوں کو ان کی دہلیز پر تعلیم کی سہولت ملنا شروع ہو گئی ہے جو کہ علاقے کی ترقی کے لیے انتہائی اہم ہے۔

stories.title: Pakistani Minister Salik Hussain Criticizes Punjab Governance and Fund Allocation
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Overseas Pakistanis Chaudhry Salik Hussain has publicly criticized governance, administrative inefficiencies, and the distribution of development funds in Punjab. In an interview, Hussain endorsed similar remarks made by Qaiser Ahmed Sheikh and claimed that systemic problems are slowing down provincial progress. He alleged that political preferences heavily influence development decisions, noting that a major portion of the provincial budget goes to Lahore while districts lacking government-backed winners risk missing out on projects.

Hussain also addressed alleged corruption in Punjab, stating that while he lacked direct documentary evidence, rumors and corruption-related files were widespread enough to fill cupboards. Furthermore, the federal minister criticized public spending on official aircraft, arguing that leaders must show greater sensitivity to economic conditions and provide clear justifications for the outcomes of official trips. He claimed that the government system faces unnecessary internal hurdles and called for greater empowerment and accountability for ministers.

Reflecting on political leadership in Punjab, Hussain praised former chief minister Chaudhry Pervez Elahi as the best he had seen in his lifetime. He credited Elahi with carrying out significant development work across the province without any political or personal discrimination. Hussain's remarks highlight ongoing political and administrative tensions regarding resource distribution and regional development priorities in Pakistan's most populous province.

The matters raised by the federal minister touch on core issues of governance and resource transparency that directly impact local populations. Matters of budget allocation, administrative hurdles, and political favoritism remain central to discussions surrounding regional development and political accountability in the country. Hussain's commentary underscores the broader challenges faced by ministers whose official authority is restricted while trying to deliver results.

stories.title: Inter Miami Ascends to Second Place After Late Comeback Win Over New England
stories.summary:
Lionel Messi scored a crucial late goal to propel Inter Miami to a 2-1 comeback victory over the New England Revolution, lifting his side into second place in the MLS Eastern Conference. Messi dribbled past three defenders before finishing past US national team goalkeeper Matt Turner in the 83rd minute, securing three points just before a late New England equalizer was disallowed for a marginal offside review.

The match remained goalless through the first half before New England broke the deadlock early in the second period. Peyton Miller cut back a pass for Ilay Feingold, who backheeled it to Daniel Gazdag to smash home. Miami equalized in the 69th minute when Telasco Segovia crossed into the box and Messi directed the ball off the back of his head to German Berterame for the finish, setting up Messi's late game-winner.

With this victory, Miami sits one point ahead of the New England Revolution with only one regular-season match remaining. A subsequent win against Charlotte on Saturday will guarantee home advantage until the Conference Finals and also secured Miami a spot in next year's CONCACAF Champions Cup. Meanwhile, the Columbus Crew and Orlando City also clinched playoff berths following the New York Red Bulls' defeat.

In other league action, Nashville extended an impressive run to tie the MLS record for most points in a single season with 74, lifting the Supporters' Shield at Geodis Park. Nashville completed an undefeated home campaign with 15 wins, showcasing a dominant home-field advantage that top seeds retain throughout the postseason leading up to the MLS Cup on December 18.

stories.title: Saad Baig Aims for Higher Scores After Promising ODI Debut
stories.summary:
Pakistan’s emerging wicketkeeper-batter Saad Baig has expressed his ambition to convert promising starts into substantial innings following his encouraging entry into international cricket. The 20-year-old accumulated 185 runs across five matches during the recent tri-nation One Day International series, which concluded with Pakistan defeating Sri Lanka by three wickets in the final at Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore.

Baig delivered a crucial knock of 74 runs in the title match to help successfully chase down a 326-run target, while also securing three catches behind the stumps. Reviewing his maiden series on a Pakistan Cricket Board digital programme, Baig emphasized his strategy to transition the confidence gained in domestic competitions directly to the international stage by trusting his natural abilities.

Reflecting on his development, the left-handed batsman highlighted the value of adapting his approach to match conditions and building partnerships. He progressed through Pakistan's youth ranks across under-13, under-16, and under-19 levels, eventually captaining the squad at the 2024 ICC Men’s Under-19 World Cup where the team reached the semi-finals.

Transitioning from age-group cricket to the senior national setup has been rewarding for Baig, especially alongside peers from his junior cohort. Looking ahead, he intends to focus on continuous learning, addressing areas of weakness, and delivering consistent performances for the national team.

stories.title: قطر نے پاکستانی شہریوں کے لیے ویزا آن ارائیول کی سہولت بحال کر دی
stories.summary:
قطر نے پاکستانی، انڈین اور تھائی شہریوں کے لیے 30 روز تک کے لیے مفت ویزا آن ارائیول کی سہولت دوبارہ بحال کر دی ہے۔ اس حوالے سے قطر کی وزارت داخلہ کے ماتحت پاسپورٹس اور سرحدی امور سے متعلق محکمے کی ویب سائٹ پر باضابطہ شرائط شائع کر دی گئی ہیں۔ یہ سہولت مخصوص شرائط کے ساتھ دی جا رہی ہے۔

اہلیت کے لیے مسافر کے پاس کم از کم تین ماہ تک کارآمد پاسپورٹ، آمد و رفت کا تصدیق شدہ فضائی ٹکٹ، ڈسکور قطر پلیٹ فارم کے ذریعے ہوٹل کی بکنگ اور منظور شدہ ادارے کی ہیلتھ انشورنس ہونا لازمی ہے۔ پاکستان کی وزارت خارجہ کی ہدایات کے مطابق مسافروں کو قطر روانگی سے قبل چند اضافی تقاضے بھی پورے کرنا ہوں گے۔

وزارت خارجہ کے مطابق انشورنس کے لیے کم از کم ایک ماہ کا سرٹیفکیٹ درکار ہے جس کی قیمت 50 قطری ریال یعنی تقریباً 3800 پاکستانی روپے بتائی گئی ہے۔ انشورنس کے لیے قطر انشورنس کمپنی (کیو آئی سی) اور لائف اینڈ میڈیکل انشورنس کمپنی (کیو ایل ایم) کو ترجیح دینے کا کہا گیا ہے جبکہ انشورنس مکمل ہونے پر ای میل موصول ہوتی ہے۔

دوحہ پہنچنے پر مسافروں کو امیگریشن سے پہلے حمد انٹرنیشنل ایئرپورٹ پر موجود ڈسکور قطر ڈیسک سے رجوع کر کے کاغذات کی تصدیق کرانا ہوگی۔ اس کے بعد امیگریشن کاؤنٹرز پر ویزا کارروائی، آنکھوں کی سکیننگ اور بائیومیٹرک کے مراحل مکمل کیے جائیں گے۔ رواں برس مارچ میں یہ سہولت عارضی طور پر معطل کی گئی تھی لیکن اب اسے بحال کر دیا گیا ہے۔

stories.title: Investigation Record in Mir Raza Ali Case Transferred to Joint Investigation Team
stories.summary:
The investigation into the death of 25-year-old businessman and Institute of Business Administration graduate Mir Raza Ali has been formally transferred to a Joint Investigation Team (JIT). Headed by Deputy Inspector General Irfan Baloch, the JIT will oversee further proceedings and examine all evidence related to the case. Mir Raza Ali had gone missing on July 28 after leaving his home in PECHS, and his body bearing gunshot wounds was discovered a day later in bushes located in Gulistan-e-Jauhar.

Deputy Superintendent of Police Siraj Lashari confirmed that all relevant documents and records had been handed over to the joint investigation body. A representative of the JIT is scheduled to appear before the court to provide a progress report on the ongoing investigation. The transition marks a new phase in the inquiry as authorities attempt to uncover the full circumstances surrounding the entrepreneur's death.

The formation of the JIT follows adjustments requested by the victim's father, Mir Hussain. After expressing gratitude to the Sindh government for establishing the team, Mir Hussain requested the replacement of the initial National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency representative, Arslan Manzoor. Although acknowledging the officer's competence, the father noted that the official had previously focused on a suicide narrative during two months of work and advocated for an officer with a fresh perspective.

The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency subsequently nominated Deputy Director Shehzad Akbar to represent the agency on the panel. The updated JIT is now tasked with reviewing the comprehensive case file and pursuing all leads regarding the young businessman's death. The family and public continue to follow the investigation closely as judicial and law enforcement bodies advance their inquiries.

stories.title: Saudi Civil Defence Issues All-Clear After Intercepting Houthi Ballistic Missile Attack
stories.summary:
Saudi Arabia’s civil defence authority announced that a security threat had passed shortly after issuing alerts for several southern and western cities, including Khamis Mushait, Abha, Taif, and Najran. The precautionary warnings coincided with weeks of escalating hostilities between the kingdom and Yemen’s Houthi movement. The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen stated that it successfully intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by the Houthis toward the southern region of the kingdom.

The southern regions of Saudi Arabia, which share a border with Yemen, have frequently been targeted by Houthi drone and missile strikes. These attacks have historically focused on military installations and critical energy infrastructure, including sites in Jazan. The continued cross-border hostilities pose significant risks to Saudi Arabia's domestic energy production, oil refineries, and vital export supply chains situated near the Red Sea coast.

In response to the persistent airborne threats, the Saudi-led coalition has carried out retaliatory airstrikes against Houthi positions inside Yemen. The renewed violence highlights ongoing vulnerabilities surrounding regional energy facilities, including the East-West pipeline and oil export terminals in Yanbu. These continuous escalations underscore the persistent security challenges facing Saudi infrastructure amid the prolonged conflict in Yemen.

stories.title: Warriors Secure Third Consecutive Victory Against Champions in Faisalabad
stories.summary:
The Warriors cricket team secured a comfortable 24-run win over the Champions in the fifth match of the PCB Women’s Super-3 T20 Tournament at Iqbal Stadium in Faisalabad on Monday. Muneeba Ali's Warriors defended a total of 154-8, bowling out Tuba Hassan's Champions side for 130 in 19.2 overs to claim their third consecutive win of the tournament.

Batting first after losing the toss, the Warriors recovered from a shaky start at 66-4 thanks to a 65-run partnership between Hafsa Khalid, who scored 47 runs from 36 balls, and Rameen Shamim, who added 29 runs. Diana Baig contributed a quick 19 runs off 14 balls to help set a 155-run target. Tayyaba Imdad picked up two wickets for the Champions.

In response, the Champions fell short despite resistance from Natalia Parvaiz with 31 runs and Shawaal Zulfiqar with 22 runs. Left-arm spinner Ayesha Bilal dismantled the batting lineup by taking four wickets for 15 runs, earning the player of the match award. Diana Baig and Zunash Abdul Sattar each claimed two wickets to seal the victory.

With this win, the Warriors maintain their unbeaten streak and prepare to face the Incredibles in their next match on Tuesday. Meanwhile, the Champions have secured a berth in the final after winning two of their four matches, while the Incredibles have been eliminated from the race after losing all three of their outings.

stories.title: Australia Unveils New-Look White-Ball Squads for Upcoming England Series
stories.summary:
Australia has selected a fresh mix of players for upcoming white-ball matches against England, featuring several emerging talents and uncapped names alongside experienced figures. Mitchell Marsh has been named as the captain for both the one-day international and Twenty20 squads.

Chairman of selectors George Bailey noted that these fixtures offer a strong platform for players to prove themselves against formidable opponents. The selections feature young fast bowler Mahli Beardman, allrounders Jack Edwards and Liam Scott, as well as batting prospects Ollie Peake and Jake Fraser-McGurk. Wicketkeepers Lachlan Shaw and Sam Harper also earned spots, with Harper and Shaw being the two uncapped players in the group.

Australia is set to play three home ODIs against England from November 13 to 18, followed by five T20 matches. These games serve as vital preparation for the next generation ahead of the 2027 World Cup, which will be held in South Africa, Zimbabwe, and Namibia. Meanwhile, senior fast bowlers Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, and Josh Hazlewood are being rested following a demanding Test series in South Africa.

Following the white-ball series, Australia faces a busy schedule that includes a home Test series against New Zealand, an upcoming tour of India, and an Ashes campaign. Selectors are carefully monitoring player workloads to balance physical and mental preparation amidst the demanding international calendar.

stories.title: Israeli Strikes Leave Three Dead in Gaza Amid Stalled Ceasefire Talks
stories.summary:
Israeli airstrikes resulted in the deaths of at least three Palestinians and left several others wounded across the Gaza Strip. Health officials in the territory confirmed the casualties following the latest escalation in violence.

Medics reported that two individuals were killed and six others injured in two distinct airstrikes targeting Khan Younis in the southern part of the enclave. A third fatality was recorded due to an Israeli airstrike in the town of Al-Mussadar. The Israeli military did not immediately issue a comment regarding these specific military operations.

The recent intensification of strikes comes as Israel accuses the Hamas militant group of rearming and initiating attacks in violation of a year-old ceasefire agreement. Hamas has strongly denied these allegations, countering that Israel is attempting to undermine the existing peace deal and obstructing reconstruction efforts in the territory.

Negotiations have stalled as parties fail to agree on terms regarding the disarmament of Hamas or the withdrawal of Israeli troops. Israeli forces currently control approximately two-thirds of Gaza, leaving more than two million residents largely confined to the remaining third amidst extensive war ruins and makeshift shelters. Local health authorities report that at least 1,580 Palestinians have died in attacks since the ceasefire began, adding to a death toll exceeding 74,000 since the broader conflict erupted on October 7, 2023.

stories.title: نظامِ شمسی میں نیا ممکنہ بونا سیارہ دریافت کر لیا گیا
stories.summary:
ماہرینِ فلکیات نے نظامِ شمسی میں ایک انتہائی بڑا ممکنہ بونا سیارہ دریافت کیا ہے جس نے سائنسدانوں کو حیرت میں مبتلا کر دیا ہے۔ اس پراسرار خلائی جسم کا قطر تین سو ستر سے نو سو تیس میل کے درمیان بتایا گیا ہے، جو اسے نظامِ شمسی کے سب سے بڑے بونے سیاروں کی فہرست میں شامل کر سکتا ہے۔ عارضی طور پر اس دریافت کو دو ہزار چھبیس ای ڈی ایک سو تراسی کا نام دیا گیا ہے، اور باضابطہ تصدیق کے بعد اسے یونانی نام دیا جا سکتا ہے۔

یہ اہم دریافت چلی کے آٹھ ہزار آٹھ سو فٹ بلند پہاڑ کی چوٹی پر نصب طاقتور ویرا سی روبن دوربین کے ذریعے عمل میں آئی۔ ماہرِ فلکیات میتھیو ہولمین نے دو ہزار چھبیس کے دوران اس دوربین سے ملنے والے ڈیٹا کا جائزہ لینے کے لیے ایک جدید کمپیوٹر پروگرام کا استعمال کیا۔ یہ سسٹم اربوں متحرک خلائی اجسام کی جانچ کر رہا تھا جب اس کی نظر اس نئے ممکنہ بونے سیارے پر پڑی۔

اگر اس کا قطر زیادہ سے زیادہ یعنی نو سو تیس میل تک نکلا تو یہ برطانیہ کی لمبائی سے بھی زیادہ چوڑا ثابت ہوگا۔ اس سے قبل اس محدود اور مخصوص گروپ میں سیرس، پلوٹو، ہاؤمیا، میک میک اور ایریس جیسے بونے سیارے شامل ہیں۔ اس دریافت کے بعد نظامِ شمسی کے پوشیدہ رازوں کو سمجھنے میں مزید مدد ملنے کی توقع کی جارہی ہے۔

stories.title: Coach Andrew McDonald Defends Australia Despite Series Defeat in South Africa
stories.summary:
Australia cricket coach Andrew McDonald has defended his squad despite a 2-1 series loss to South Africa, which triggered significant public criticism and calls for sweeping changes. Conceding that the team underperformed during the tour, McDonald emphasized that the lineup still contains high-caliber players.

The disappointment culminated in the final day of the third test at Newlands, where Australia was bowled out for 111 while chasing a target of 288. The defeat marked the team's third loss in five tests, costing them their top world ranking and complicating their path to the World Test Championship final. Critics have raised concerns over an aging test squad and a perceived reluctance to transition younger players into the side.

McDonald addressed individual performances, noting that Marnus Labuschagne struggled on the tour with 131 runs at an average of 21.83, though he stopped short of closing the door on the batsman's future. Veteran Steve Smith missed the final test due to a neck issue but is expected to be fit for the upcoming home series against New Zealand. Despite the struggles of spinner Nathan Lyon, McDonald pointed to positives such as Cameron Green's successful return from injury and Josh Inglis scoring a century.

Looking ahead, Australia prepares for a four-test home series against New Zealand in December and January, followed by a five-match series in India. McDonald stressed the importance of careful evaluation through domestic Sheffield Shield cricket rather than making hasty decisions in the immediate aftermath of the tour.

stories.title: Doctors Across Pakistan Launch Two-Day Boycott Over FIRs and FBR Policies
stories.summary:
Medical professionals across Pakistan have initiated a two-day protest by suspending outpatient department services at public and private hospitals, as well as private clinics. The nationwide action was organized by the Pakistan Medical Association to oppose government policies and legal challenges facing healthcare workers.

The decision to halt routine services stems from a unanimous resolution adopted by doctors nationwide and directives from central leadership. While outpatient services and private clinics remain closed in cities like Karachi, hospital emergency departments continue to operate normally to ensure urgent patient care is not disrupted.

The protest highlights four primary grievances affecting the medical community: the filing of allegedly unjustified first information reports against doctors, related legal proceedings, instances of alleged humiliation and harassment, and the Federal Board of Revenue's compulsory implementation of the Point of Sale system.

PMA Karachi leaders emphasized the vital need to protect the professional independence and dignity of medical practitioners. The association has urged healthcare institutions and professionals to support the shutdown while assuring the public that emergency medical facilities remain fully functional to handle immediate needs.

stories.title: Kimi Antonelli Makes History as Formula One's Youngest Champion
stories.summary:
Twenty-year-old Kimi Antonelli secured the Formula One world championship in Mexico on Sunday, finishing third behind Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton. By clinching the title with four races remaining in the season, the young Italian broke Sebastian Vettel's long-standing record to become the youngest champion in F1 history at 20 years and 68 days old. He is also the first Italian to win the championship in 73 years, following Alberto Ascari.

Flung into Formula One in 2025 at just 18 years old, Antonelli enjoyed a stellar second season with Mercedes, comfortably outperforming his British teammate George Russell. After finishing second in the Australian season opener, Antonelli dominated by winning the next five races and arriving in Mexico with nine victories out of 18 events. His campaign featured standout moments, including a remarkable drive in Monza where he started 19th and worked his way through the field to win his home grand prix.

Born to mother Elisabetta and father Marco, a former driver and team principal, Antonelli began karting at age seven despite his father's initial hesitation regarding the financial and physical cruelties of motorsport. Discovered at age 11 by Gwen Lagrue, head of the Mercedes junior driver programme, Antonelli rose rapidly through karting, Italian and German F4, and Formula Regional before leaping straight to F2 and subsequently into F1 following Lewis Hamilton's departure to Ferrari. Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff praised the rookie's ability to handle intense pressure, media scrutiny, and high expectations.

Off the track, Antonelli has charmed the F1 paddock with his cheerful personality, humor, and lighthearted pranks directed at his race engineer, Peter Bonnington. With his combination of raw speed, mental resilience, and technical skill, the young Italian has established himself as a dominant force in the sport, earning praise from mentors and rivals alike as he secures his place at the pinnacle of motorsport.

stories.title: Pakistan Health Ministry and Sehat Kahani Launch Phase Two Telemedicine
stories.summary:
The Ministry of Health and digital healthcare platform Sehat Kahani signed a Memorandum of Understanding in Islamabad on Monday to advance telemedicine cooperation. Federal Minister for Health Syed Mustafa Kamal and representatives from Sehat Kahani participated in the signing ceremony.

Speaking at the event, Syed Mustafa Kamal stated that the government has successfully concluded the initial phase of its telemedicine initiative and is now advancing to the second phase. During the first phase, the collaboration resulted in the creation of 10 telemedicine centers, and the latest agreement will introduce an additional 10 centers.

Furthermore, the federal minister announced that the Outdoor Patient Department and the Trauma Center at the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences are being integrated into the expanding telemedicine network. These measures are designed to enhance accessibility and healthcare quality for the general public.

The initiative is part of ongoing efforts by leadership, including the former Karachi mayor and Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan leader, to implement practical health sector improvements and elevate living standards for common citizens across the country through digital health integration.

stories.title: Candice Swanepoel and Tom Brady Spark Engagement Rumours in Florida
stories.summary:
Supermodel Candice Swanepoel and retired NFL star Tom Brady have sparked widespread engagement speculation after the model was spotted wearing a gold band on her left ring finger. The 37-year-old Victoria’s Secret Angel was seen wearing the jewellery with an all-black outfit in Surfside, Florida, in late October 2026.

Despite the buzz surrounding the sighting, there is no official confirmation of an engagement, and neither Brady nor Swanepoel has publicly addressed the relationship rumours. Reports suggest the ring may simply be a personal fashion choice rather than a proposal token. Dating speculation involving the pair first surfaced via Us Weekly and People, with TMZ sources reporting that their relationship began in June with private meetings around Miami.

Swanepoel, a South African supermodel famous for her work with Victoria’s Secret, also established the sustainable swimwear brand Tropic of C in 2018. She shares two sons, Anacan and Ariel, with her former fiancé Hermann Nicoli, whom she split from in 2018 after more than ten years together. In addition to the relationship buzz, Page Six reported alleged tension between Swanepoel and fellow model Joan Smalls, who was previously linked to Brady, though Swanepoel's representative emphasized a longstanding friendship and mutual respect between the two models.

The unconfirmed engagement rumours continue to draw public attention as both stars maintain privacy regarding their personal lives. The mysterious gold ring remains the sole focal point of the current speculation as neither party provides clarity on their relationship status.

stories.title: Carlos Alcaraz Wins Vienna Open to Claim Fourth Title of Season
stories.summary:
Carlos Alcaraz secured the Vienna Open title on Sunday by defeating Alex de Minaur in straight sets, 6-1, 6-4. The victory marks the Spaniard's fourth title of the season and the 28th of his career, while extending his impressive ATP 500 winning streak to 26 matches.

The 23-year-old world number two arrived in the Austrian capital following previous tournament victories in Doha and Tokyo. By maintaining a flawless 16-0 record at ATP 500 events in 2026, Alcaraz capped off a dominant week in which he did not drop a single set across his five tournament matches.

Alcaraz immediately took control of the final by breaking De Minaur's serve in the opening game and securing a double-break advantage. Although the 27-year-old Australian put up stronger resistance in the second set, Alcaraz utilized a high-quality all-court performance to close out the contest in 97 minutes, marking his seventh consecutive victory over De Minaur.

Following this success, Alcaraz heads into the upcoming Paris Masters with high confidence after already securing qualification for the season-ending ATP Finals in Turin. Meanwhile, De Minaur will also shift his focus to Paris as he aims to secure his third consecutive qualification for the ATP Finals.

stories.title: Pakistan Assumes Chairmanship of SCO Interbank Consortium for 2026-27
stories.summary:
Pakistan has officially assumed the chairmanship of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Interbank Consortium (SCO-IBC) for the 2026-27 term, according to an announcement by the Ministry of Finance on Monday. HBL Chairman Sultan Ali Allana has taken charge as the head of the consortium for this period.

The Ministry of Finance noted that this leadership transition coincides with Pakistan's broader chairmanship of the SCO for the same timeframe. This dual role highlights the nation's active involvement in advancing regional trade, investment, financial connectivity, and economic cooperation among member states.

The ministry congratulated Sultan Ali Allana and reiterated Pakistan's dedication to building stronger economic partnerships, facilitating cross-border commerce, and promoting regional integration. The SCO-IBC serves as a vital financial cooperation platform aimed at fostering sustainable development through collaboration with multilateral institutions and exploring transnational mega projects.

This development builds on Pakistan's growing engagement with the regional organization since attaining full membership in 2017. Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar has emphasized that Pakistan's leadership roles reflect confidence in its regional standing, following previous hosting duties and ongoing chairmanship responsibilities in counter-terrorism and poverty alleviation working groups.

stories.title: Bangladesh Garment Factories Reopen After Wage Protests Cause Shutdowns
stories.summary:
Garment factories across Bangladesh reopened on Monday following widespread closures and disruptions a day earlier. The ready-made apparel industry makes up over 80 percent of the nation's export earnings, provides jobs for roughly 4 million individuals, and contributes about 10 percent to the gross domestic product. As the world's second-largest apparel exporter behind China, the country faced production halts in key hubs as employees demanded a minimum monthly wage increase from 12,500 taka to 30,000 taka due to soaring living costs and persistent inflation. In response to the demonstrations, the government established a six-member minimum wage board on Sunday, though the measure did not immediately halt the unrest. Protesters erected road blockades in several industrial districts, prompting law enforcement in Dhaka to deploy tear gas and water cannons to disperse the crowds. Babul Akhter, a workers' representative on the board, stated that the country maintains some of the lowest garment wages globally and argued that factory owners must negotiate better pricing with international buyers rather than relying on underpaid labor. Factory owners noted that the sector deals with elevated operational costs, slowing demand in major export markets, and energy market uncertainty driven by Middle East conflicts. According to the Bangladesh Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association, demonstrations affected 529 factories and nearly 1 million workers. BGMEA President Mahmud Hasan Khan urged workers to let the review process proceed, warning that further shutdowns would force the implementation of a 'no work, no pay' policy.
Selim Raihan, an economics professor at the University of Dhaka, noted that the demands are understandable amid high inflation, but warned that significant wage hikes could raise production expenses, compress profit margins, and reduce the price competitiveness of Bangladesh. He suggested that a phased adjustment, enhanced productivity, and fairer pricing from global buyers are vital for balancing employee welfare with industrial sustainability.

stories.title: قبائلی اضلاع کو تجربہ گاہ نہ بنایا جائے، اصل مسئلہ معدنیات ہے: فضل الرحمان
stories.summary:
پشاور میں ڈیجیٹل میڈیا ورکرز جمعیت فاٹا کنونشن سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے جمعیت علمائے اسلام (ف) کے سربراہ مولانا فضل الرحمان نے کہا ہے کہ قبائلی اضلاع کو طویل عرصے سے تجربہ گاہ بنایا جا رہا ہے۔ انہوں نے دعویٰ کیا کہ ان علاقوں کا اصل مسئلہ کوئی اور نہیں بلکہ وہاں موجود معدنی وسائل ہیں، جن کے معاہدے عوام کے سامنے لائے جانے چاہئیں۔

مولانا فضل الرحمان کا کہنا تھا کہ قبائلی علاقوں کے انضمام کو تقریباً دس سال ہونے والے ہیں لیکن وہاں اب تک بندوبستی علاقوں جیسا انتظامی نظام قائم نہیں کیا جا سکا۔ انہوں نے سوال اٹھایا کہ اگر انضمام کا فیصلہ غلط تھا تو یہ کس کے کہنے پر کیا گیا تھا اور اب اسے ختم کرنے کی باتیں کیوں کی جا رہی ہیں۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ قیمتی پتھر امریکی حکام کے دفاتر میں پیش کیے گئے ہیں اور امریکی بھی اس معاملے میں پیشرفت کا اعتراف کر چکے ہیں۔

گورنر راج اور ایمرجنسی کے نفاذ پر بات کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے کہا کہ یہ اقدامات دہشت گردی کے بیانیے پر کیے گئے جو بعد میں ختم ہو گیا۔ انہوں نے کوہاٹ کو بھی ایمرجنسی والے اضلاع میں شامل کرنے کی تیاریوں کا انکشاف کیا اور کہا کہ کابینہ کے فیصلوں میں ان کی بات نہیں سنی گئی۔ انہوں نے زور دیا کہ ریاست قبائلی عوام کے خدشات دور کرے اور ان کے وسائل کے معاہدے منظر عام پر لائے۔

سیاسی صورتحال پر گفتگو کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے کہا کہ الزام تراشی اور کردار کشی سے سیاسی ماحول خراب ہو رہا ہے اور وہ گالی گلوچ کے بجائے باہمی مکالمے پر یقین رکھتے ہیں۔ انہوں نے وزیراعظم اور دیگر سیاسی جماعتوں کے ساتھ مذاکرات کے ذریعے مسائل کے حل پر زور دیتے ہوئے کہا کہ ملک کی ترقی کے لیے صحت مند سیاسی ماحول کا ہونا انتہائی ضروری ہے۔

stories.title: چہرے کی ڈھیلی جلد اور جھریوں کے خاتمے کا آسان گھریلو نسخہ
stories.summary:
عمر میں اضافے، موسم کی تبدیلی اور نمی کی کمی کی وجہ سے چہرے کی جلد اپنی رونق اور لچک کھونے لگتی ہے، جس سے باریک جھریاں بھی نمایاں ہونے لگتی ہیں۔ ان مسائل سے نمٹنے کے لیے مہنگی بیوٹی پراڈکٹس کے بجائے روایتی گھریلو ٹوٹکوں کو بہت زیادہ ترجیح دی جاتی ہے، جن میں انڈے کی سفیدی سے تیار کردہ فیس ماسک سرفہرست ہے۔

انڈے کی سفیدی کا یہ ماسک جلد میں عارضی کھنچاؤ پیدا کرنے کے لیے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔ اس ماسک کو بنانے کا طریقہ انتہائی آسان ہے جس میں چند ہی اشیاء استعمال ہوتی ہیں۔ سب سے پہلے انڈے کی سفیدی کو زردی سے الگ کر کے ایک صاف پیالی میں ڈالا جاتا ہے۔

اس پیالی میں چینی اور وٹامن ای کا تیل شامل کیا جاتا ہے اور پھر کانٹے کی مدد سے آمیزے کو اس وقت تک اچھی طرح پھینٹا جاتا ہے جب تک وہ جھاگ دار نہ ہو جائے۔ اس تیار شدہ آمیزے کو چہرے پر لگایا جاتا ہے اور پندرہ سے بیس منٹ گزرنے کے بعد چہرے کو نیم گرم پانی سے دھو لیا جاتا ہے۔

stories.title: Islamabad High Court Sets Hearing For PTI Founder Jail Visit Petition
stories.summary:
The Islamabad High Court has scheduled a hearing for November 5 regarding a petition that requests permission to visit the founder of PTI in jail. The case was fixed for Thursday following initial objections raised by the high court's registrar office. The petition was submitted by members of the national dialogue committee, including Fawad Chaudhry, Imran Ismail, Mahmood Moulvi, and Barrister Saif. The respondents named in the legal filing include the interior secretary, the secretary of the Punjab home department, and the superintendent of Adiala Jail. The petitioners expressed concern over the health of the PTI founder, noting they are his friends. They stated that visits have been prohibited for the past several months, which has fueled rumors on social media and generated anxiety among the general public. According to the plea, the prohibition on jail meetings breaches Articles 9 and 14, violates existing jail regulations, and contradicts the United Nations' Nelson Mandela rules. The petitioners argued that coming to court is necessary to support political stability, constitutional supremacy, and national reconciliation.
The applicants formally requested the court to direct the jail superintendent to permit a visit in accordance with Pakistan Prison Rules. Separately, in Kuwait City, the Ministry of Interior arrested a motorist for reckless driving after a surveillance video of dangerous maneuvers circulated on social media, leading the Ahmadi Governorate Security Directorate to seize the vehicle in the Ali Sabah Al-Salem area.

stories.title: Lahore Ranks as World's Most Polluted City With Air Quality Index of 509
stories.summary:
Lahore remained the most polluted city globally on Monday, registering an Air Quality Index reading of 509. The Indian capital of New Delhi held the second position with an AQI of 221, while Cairo, Egypt, placed third with an AQI of 201. Additional cities featuring poor air quality included Dhaka at 167, Shanghai at 161, and Kolkata at 158. Reports indicate that polluted air moving from Amritsar and Attari in India contributes to the rising AQI levels in Lahore. Officials noted that water is being sprayed using smoke guns to help lower pollution levels, and added that an increase in wind speed by 11:00 am could lead to improvements in air quality. Seasonal smog and air pollution consistently impact Punjab as temperatures drop with the arrival of winter. Provincial Minister Marriyum Aurangzeb called upon farmers to refrain from burning crop remnants and advised residents to utilize car-pooling. She additionally emphasized that vehicles lacking fitness certificates should not be operated on public roads. Previous authorities have implemented measures to address severe smog caused by low-grade diesel fumes and agricultural burning, which previously pushed pollution levels to more than 80 times the hygienic threshold set by the World Health Organization.
To protect the public from the severe health consequences of toxic pollution, the government has previously closed educational institutions and placed restrictions on the operating hours of eateries, markets, and other businesses. Meanwhile, in Kuwait City, the Ministry of Interior apprehended a motorist accused of reckless driving following surveillance by the Vehicle Operations Section.

stories.title: Wafi Energy Pakistan Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Dividend
stories.summary:
The Board of Directors of Wafi Energy Pakistan Limited released its financial performance figures for the nine months concluding on September 30, 2026. The company reported a profit after tax of PKR 6,558 million for the period, marking an increase from PKR 3,030 million during the corresponding timeframe in the previous year. These financial results were declared against a backdrop of global oil market volatility, supply-side pressures, and a demanding operational environment. Alongside the earnings report, WEPL declared a dividend of PKR 4 per share. During the nine-month period, WEPL advanced its retail footprint by incorporating 54 new Shell retail locations, 26 Shell Select stores, and nine Shell Recharge electric vehicle charging stations. The company maintained its service delivery across consumer and industrial lubricants through various product offerings and customer engagement strategies. Growth in the retail sector and customer offerings was further reinforced by new alliances and partnerships. In community development, WEPL supported children’s education via a collaboration with The Dawood Foundation’s MagnifiScience Centre. The organization also achieved first place in the IFC-Pakistan Business Council’s Climate2Equal initiative through its Access to Energy program, which aids women and rural populations. Furthermore, Shell honored WEPL as the Shell Licensee of the Year 2025 among its global licensees, acknowledging the company's business performance, operational standards, safety measures, and customer service. Chief Executive Officer Zubair Shaikh remarked that the firm successfully expanded its retail network and non-fuel retail offerings despite operating challenges.
Shaikh expressed pride in the team's accomplishments and affirmed that the company will maintain its investments to build upon this progress and deliver long-term value to shareholders and Pakistan. Wafi Energy Pakistan Limited intends to continue this trajectory while ensuring a reliable energy supply to support the evolving energy demands of the country.

stories.title: London Copper Prices Rebound Amid Global Supply Tightness and Oil Decline
stories.summary:
Benchmark copper values on the London Metal Exchange recovered on Monday, rising 0.55 percent to reach $14,233 per metric ton by 0326 GMT. This upward movement followed losses in the previous week and was largely driven by international supply anxieties, reduced production projections, and decreasing petroleum costs.

Market pressures stem from multiple global factors, including lowering output estimates for 2026 released by Chile's copper commission, Cochilco. Additionally, regional logistical bottlenecks have formed in the United States due to an influx of metal inventories ahead of potential tariffs on refined copper imports. In China, the leading global consumer, physical market tightness pushed the Yangshan premium to $200 per ton, near a ten-year peak, while warehouse inventories monitored by the Shanghai Futures Exchange dropped by over 75 percent during the prior six months.

Macroeconomic conditions also contributed to the price recovery, as petroleum costs declined while officials from Iran and Qatar engaged in a third consecutive day of discussions to negotiate an end to the conflict involving the United States, Israel, and Iran. ING analysts noted that underlying physical market fundamentals remain supportive. The decrease in oil values helps relieve pressure on global economic activity and bolsters consumption of industrial metals.

Other base metals on the London Metal Exchange displayed mixed outcomes during the session. Aluminium declined by 0.57 percent, zinc dropped 0.16 percent, and lead increased by 0.08 percent, while nickel and tin advanced by 1.4 percent and 1.34 percent, respectively. Meanwhile, contracts on the Shanghai Futures Exchange showed aluminium down 1.04 percent, zinc lower by 1.18 percent, lead down 0.25 percent, nickel dropping 0.66 percent, and tin falling 0.44 percent, with the most-traded Shanghai copper contract slipping 0.35 percent to 108,630 yuan, equivalent to $16,338.78 per ton.

stories.title: India Evacuates Thousands Along Eastern Coast Ahead of Cyclone Murasu
stories.summary:
Government officials along the eastern coast of India initiated widespread evacuations on Monday in anticipation of an incoming severe weather system. Cyclone Murasu formed over the Bay of Bengal and is projected by the India Meteorological Department to strike the coastline during the early hours of Tuesday.

The impending storm threatens an area still recovering from Cyclone Arnab, a previous weather event that struck the region last week, resulting in six fatalities alongside widespread destruction of residential properties and agricultural crops. Officials report that Cyclone Murasu is expected to exhibit lower intensity than the earlier storm.

Prakhar Jain, the managing director of the Andhra Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority, stated that approximately 2,000 residents had already been relocated by Monday, with ongoing operations aiming to evacuate roughly 30,000 individuals in total from vulnerable locations.

The India Meteorological Department forecasts that the states of Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh, situated along the southeastern coastline, will experience the most severe impacts of the storm. The Bay of Bengal is recognized as a major basin for tropical storms that frequently generate destructive weather events affecting India's eastern shores.

stories.title: لاہور میں نوکری کا جھانسہ دے کر خاتون کو زیادتی کا نشانہ بنانے والا ملزم گرفتار
stories.summary:
لاہور کے علاقے کوٹ لکھپت میں نوکری کا لالچ دے کر ایک شادی شدہ خاتون کو اجتماعی زیادتی کا نشانہ بنانے والے مرکزی ملزم کو پولیس نے گرفتار کر لیا ہے جبکہ اس کا دوسرا ساتھی تحال فرار ہے۔ ایس پی ماڈل ٹاؤن کے مطابق پولیس نے فوری کارروائی کرتے ہوئے مقدمے میں ملوث ملزم وسیم کو حراست میں لے لیا ہے۔

مقدمے کی تفصیلات کے مطابق مفرور ملزم ذیشان نے متاثرہ خاتون کو فیکٹری میں کام دلوانے کا جھانسہ دے کر چنگی اسٹاپ پر بلایا تھا۔ ملزم خاتون کو کام دلانے کے بہانے مختلف مقامات پر گھماتا رہا اور بعد میں ورغللا کر غلام بھٹی کالونی میں اپنے ساتھی وسیم کے گھر لے گیا جہاں دونوں نے مبینہ طور پر اسے زیادتی کا نشانہ بنایا۔

واردات کے بعد ملزمان خاتون کو ٹھوکر نیاز بیگ کے قریب چھوڑ کر فرار ہو گئے۔ پولیس نے گرفتار ملزم سے تفتیش شروع کر دی ہے جبکہ دوسرے مفرور ملزم ذیشان کی گرفتاری کے لیے مختلف مقامات پر چھاپے مارے جا رہے ہیں۔ حکام کا عزم ہے کہ خواتین کا استحصال کرنے والے عناصر کسی بھی رعایت کے مستحق نہیں ہیں۔

stories.title: بلوچستان میں تصدیق کا عمل جاری، ایک لاکھ اڑتیس ہزار مشتبہ شناختی کارڈز بلاک
stories.summary:
نادرا حکام کی جانب سے بلوچستان بھر میں ایک لاکھ اڑتیس ہزار سے زائد مشتبہ شناختی کارڈز بلاک کر دیے گئے ہیں۔ حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ ان بلاک کیے گئے شناختی کارڈز کی جانچ پڑتال اور تصدیق کا عمل فی الحال جاری ہے۔

تصدیق کے عمل کے دوران مقررہ معیار پر پورا اترنے والے تمام افراد کے شناختی کارڈز کو بحال کیا جا رہا ہے۔ اس اقدام کا مقصد ملکی سلامتی اور قواعد و ضوابط کو یقینی بنانا ہے، جبکہ نادرا اس معاملے میں قانونی اور انتظامی تقاضے پورے کر رہا ہے۔

اس کے علاوہ ملک کے دیگر حصوں میں بھی مختلف نوعیت کی انتظامی اور سیکیورٹی کارروائیاں جاری ہیں۔ حکام کے مطابق سیکیورٹی فورسز روزانہ کی بنیاد پر اوسطاً دو سو انٹیلی جنس بیسڈ آپریشنز انجام دے رہی ہیں تاکہ اندرونی اور بیرونی خطرات سے نمٹا جا سکے۔

متعلقہ اداروں کی جانب سے اس عمل کو مزید شفاف اور مؤثر بنانے کے لیے اقدامات کیے جا رہے ہیں۔ حکام اس بات پر زور دے رہے ہیں کہ صرف تصدیق شدہ اور قانونی طور پر اہل شہریوں کو ہی دستاویزات کی بحالی کی سہولت فراہم کی جائے گی۔

stories.title: کے پی میں دہشتگردی کی راہ میں رکاوٹ بننے والے سہولت کار اب نہیں رہے، ڈی جی آئی ایس پی آر
stories.summary:
ڈائریکٹر جنرل (ڈی جی) آئی ایس پی آر لیفٹیننٹ جنرل احمد شریف چوہدری نے ایک انٹرویو میں بتایا ہے کہ خیبر پختونخوا کی سابقہ نااہل حکومت دہشت گردوں کے سہولت کاروں میں شامل تھی۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ صوبے میں انسدادِ دہشت گردی کی راہ میں رکاوٹ پیدا کرنے والے وہ تمام سہولت کار اب موجود نہیں ہیں۔

انہوں نے مزید بتایا کہ سیکیورٹی فورسز پولیس اور دیگر قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں کے ساتھ مل کر روزانہ کی بنیاد پر تقریباً 200 انٹیلی جنس بیسڈ آپریشنز انجام دے رہی ہیں۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ دہشت گردوں کی قیادت، تربیتی کیمپ اور حملوں کے لیے تمام اڈے افغانستان کے اندر موجود ہیں، جن کے خلاف مؤثر حکمتِ عملی کے تحت کارروائیاں جاری ہیں۔

ڈی جی آئی ایس پی آر نے زور دیا کہ ریاست کی موجودگی سے ہی جمہوریت اور سیاست کا وجود ہے، اس لیے سیاستدانوں کو چاہیے کہ وہ نیشنل ایکشن پلان پر مکمل عمل درآمد کریں۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ کے پی میں حکومت کی تبدیلی آئینی اور قانونی ضوابط کے مطابق عمل میں آئی ہے اور اس معاملے پر فوج کوئی سیاسی جواب نہیں دے گی۔

آخر میں انہوں نے خیبر پختونخوا کے عوام کی قربانیوں کو خراجِ تحسین پیش کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ اس صوبے کے غیور عوام نے دہشت گردی کے خلاف جنگ میں سب سے زیادہ مشکلات کا سامنا کیا ہے۔ پختون قوم اپنی روایات پر فخر کرتی ہے اور اب وہ صوبے میں مکمل امن اور استحکام کی حقدار ہے۔

stories.title: China and Oman Elevate Bilateral Ties to a New Historical Level
stories.summary:
Chinese President Xi Jinping stated on Monday that expanding and deepening relations with Oman is a shared strategic choice for both nations. Speaking in Beijing at the start of a meeting with the Sultan of Oman, President Xi emphasized that bilateral ties have reached a new historical starting point.

During the discussions, Xi expressed his readiness to work alongside Sultan Haitham bin Tariq al-Said to guide the China-Oman strategic partnership to a higher level. He noted that this enhanced cooperation aims to better serve the populations of both countries while contributing to regional peace, stability, and prosperity, according to the media pool covering the event.

Sultan Haitham arrived in Beijing on Sunday for a two-day official visit. This visit marks the first time an Omani head of state has traveled to China since the two nations formally established diplomatic relations in 1978, underscoring the growing diplomatic engagement between the two countries.

stories.title: Pakistan Explores Tokenisation of Existing Eurobond Debt, Says Finance Minister
stories.summary:
Pakistan is actively examining the tokenisation of its existing Eurobond debt as part of broader efforts to manage sovereign debt through digital financial technologies. Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb announced the initiative on Monday while speaking at the "Dialogue on Digital Assets and the Future of Banking," an event organized by the Pakistan Banks' Association in partnership with LUMS. The government is currently holding internal discussions on the proposal and plans to seek Cabinet approval before issuing a request for proposals to move the process forward.

The finance minister encouraged commercial banks to engage actively in formulating practical digital financial proposals. He noted that banks possess valuable customer relationships, operational experience, and risk management capabilities necessary for such advancements. He advised financial institutions to invest in technological expertise and collaborate closely with relevant regulators, operating within their approved mandates and with the backing of their respective boards. This initiative aligns with Pakistan's establishment of a statutory framework for virtual assets under the Virtual Assets Act 2026, which outlines licensing and supervision through the Pakistan Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority.

While the State Bank of Pakistan has introduced a conditional pathway allowing banks to service businesses licensed by the regulatory authority subject to strict due diligence and fund segregation, existing restrictions remain. Banks are still prohibited from investing, trading, or holding virtual assets using their own capital or customer deposits. Furthermore, the finance minister underscored the critical need for robust safeguards, regulatory oversight, and cybersecurity measures, warning that financial institutions face continuous threats from both state and non-state actors, leaving no room for complacency.

stories.title: ہاتھوں کی بے رونق جلد کے لیے روایتی گھریلو نسخہ
stories.summary:
چہرے کی خوبصورتی کے لیے مختلف کریمیں اور فیس ماسک استعمال کیے جاتے ہیں لیکن اکثر لوگ ہاتھوں اور پیروں کی دیکھ بھال کو یکسر نظرانداز کر دیتے ہیں۔ روزمرہ کے گھریلو کاموں، دھوپ، گردوغبار اور خشکی کی وجہ سے ہاتھوں اور پیروں کی جلد اپنی دلکشی کھو کر بے رونق ہو جاتی ہے۔ اس مسئلے سے نمٹنے کے لیے عام گھریلو اشیا کو استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، تاہم یہ بات ذہن میں رکھنی چاہیے کہ ہر قدرتی چیز جلد کے لیے یکساں طور پر محفوظ نہیں ہوتی اس لیے گھریلو ٹوٹکے آزماتے وقت بھرپور احتیاط برتنی چاہیے۔

ہاتھوں اور پیروں کی کھوئی ہوئی رنگت بحال کرنے اور نکھار پیدا کرنے کے لیے ایک پرانا روایتی گھریلو نسخہ استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔ اس نسخے کو تیار کرنے کے لیے سبزیوں اور لیموں کا رس نکالا جاتا ہے جس میں ٹماٹر، آلو اور پیاز کا رس بھی شامل کیا جاتا ہے۔ ان تمام اجزا کو باہم ملا کر اس وقت تک اچھی طرح مکس کیا جاتا ہے جب تک یہ ایک یکجان پیسٹ کی شکل اختیار نہ کر لیں۔

تیار شدہ اس پیسٹ کو متاثرہ افراد اپنے ہاتھوں اور پیروں پر لگاتے ہیں تاکہ جلد کی رونق واپس لائی جا سکے۔ اس پیسٹ کو جلد پر کچھ دیر کے لیے چھوڑ دیا جاتا ہے اور پھر اسے صاف پانی سے اچھی طرح دھو لیا جاتا ہے۔ اس روایتی اور عام طریقہ کار سے ہاتھ پاؤں کی جلد کی صفائی اور نکھار میں مدد مل سکتی ہے۔

جلد کی دیکھ بھال کے اس قسم کے گھریلو نسخوں سے متعلق مختلف آراء پائی جاتی ہیں لیکن احتیاطی تدابیر کو اپنانا ہمیشہ ضروری قرار دیا جاتا ہے۔ اس روایتی نسخے کی تندہی سے پیروی کر کے جلد کی بیرونی حالت کو بہتر بنانے کی کوشش کی جاتی ہے۔

stories.title: Indonesia Coal Shipments Decline in Volume Despite Revenue Growth
stories.summary:
Official statistics bureau records indicate that Indonesian coal exports dropped by 10.58% during the first nine months of the year, falling to a total of 255.05 million metric tons compared to the corresponding timeframe in the previous year.

Despite the reduction in shipped volume, financial returns from these foreign sales climbed by 4.86%, reaching a total of $18.81 billion over the same nine-month period.

The statistical information compiled by the bureau originates from reports filed through the customs office, which can occasionally present discrepancies when compared against figures gathered directly from mining corporations by the Energy and Mineral Resources Ministry.

Monitoring these export fluctuations is vital for understanding Indonesia's broader economic performance, especially as regional trade dynamics shift and international energy demands continue to experience variable trends.

stories.title: Karachi Law Enforcement Seizes Stolen Phones and Arrests Fifteen Suspects
stories.summary:
Police authorities assigned to Karachi's District Central conducted multiple operations across four separate police station jurisdictions, resulting in the apprehension of 15 suspects connected to mobile device theft.

During these targeted raids, officers confiscated a total of 435 mobile units, which encompassed both stolen property and non-PTA compliant devices, along with high-end models such as expensive iPhones.

SSP Central Dr Imran informed the public during a media briefing that the confiscated electronics carry an estimated market value ranging between Rs20 million and Rs30 million, noting that several detainees operated local repair businesses.

Investigators discovered that the syndicate allegedly utilized specialized hardware to alter device IMEI numbers and execute patching procedures, making illicit and unregistered hardware operational. Authorities confirmed that street crime remains a persistent challenge and that inquiries into the network are ongoing.

stories.title: Iliana Iotova Secures Historic Presidential Victory in Bulgaria
stories.summary:
Acting President Iliana Iotova emerged victorious in the nation's presidential runoff contest, according to near-final data released by the Central Election Commission following a low voter turnout.

Processing of 99.95% of precinct protocols showed that the ticket comprising Iotova and Valchev captured 57.58% of the ballots, totaling approximately 1.1 million votes, while their rivals, Andrey Gyurov and Georgi Kandev, secured 39.47% with roughly 749,500 votes.

The decisive second round followed an initial vote on October 25 where neither opposing camp achieved the necessary majority for an immediate win, though Iotova and Valchev led that preliminary ballot with 34.6%.

Iotova previously served as vice president and transitioned to acting president in January after the former leader stepped down to contest a parliamentary race. Both figures have publicly advocated for a diplomatic resolution to the ongoing conflict in Ukraine.

stories.title: Thousands of Demonstrators in Delhi Demand Election Chief Resignation
stories.summary:
A large crowd of protesters gathered in New Delhi on Sunday, spearheaded by opposition figures including Congress Party leader Rahul Gandhi, to demand the departure of the country's chief election commissioner over controversial voter list updates.

Demonstrators marched toward the historic Ramlila Maidan ground under heavy security, asserting that a massive voter roll purge removing more than 130 million names unfairly targets minorities and disadvantages opponents of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's ruling Bharatiya Janata Party.

The protests follow an investigative report revealing internal dissent among election deputies, marking a significant political confrontation for Modi's administration despite general elections remaining scheduled for 2029.

While opposition organizers argue the revisions threaten democratic expression and disenfranchise eligible citizens, government officials and the Election Commission have defended the update as a routine effort to eliminate duplicate entries, dismissing the demonstrations as an orchestrated conspiracy.

stories.title: راولپنڈی میں دن دہاڑے ڈلیوری بوائے سے نقدی لوٹ لی گئی
stories.summary:
راولپنڈی کے علاقے تھانہ چکلالہ کی حدود میں دن دہاڑے ایک ڈکیتی کی واردات پیش آئی جہاں نامعلوم ڈاکوؤں نے ایک ڈلیوری بوائے کو اس کے اپنے گھر کے سامنے ہی نشانہ بنایا۔ پولیس ذرائع کے مطابق یہ واردات انتہائی دلیری کے ساتھ دن کے وقت کی گئی جس نے سکیورٹی کے انتظامات پر سوالیہ نشان کھڑے کر دیے ہیں۔

متاثرہ ڈلیوری بوائے جس کا نام طاہر بتایا گیا ہے، ڈاکوؤں کے سامنے بے بس ہو گیا۔ ملزمان اس سے نقدی چھین کر موقع سے فرار ہونے میں کامیاب ہو گئے۔ پولیس کے بیان کے مطابق ڈاکو طاہر سے مجموعی طور پر ایک لاکھ 30 ہزار روپے کی نقدی چھین کر باآسانی فرار ہوئے ہیں۔

اس سنگین واردات کی سی سی ٹی وی فوٹیج بھی سامنے آ چکی ہے جس میں تمام مناظر واضح طور پر دیکھے جا سکتے ہیں۔ فوٹیج میں صاف دیکھا جا سکتا ہے کہ کس طرح ملزمان نے لوٹ مار کی اور بعد میں اسلحہ فضا میں لہراتے ہوئے فرار ہونے میں کامیاب ہوئے۔

پولیس حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ واقعے کا باقاعدہ مقدمہ درج کر لیا گیا ہے اور ملزمان کی تلاش کا عمل بھی شروع کر دیا گیا ہے۔ حکام کا عزم ہے کہ سی سی ٹی وی فوٹیج کی مدد سے قانون شکنی کرنے والے عناصر کو جلد قانون کی گرفت میں لایا جائے گا۔

stories.title: Gold prices rebound on falling oil costs and Federal Reserve commentary
stories.summary:
Gold prices experienced a rebound following a steep selloff in the previous session. Spot gold increased by 0.7% to reach $3,900.90 per ounce by 0440 GMT after touching a one-year low, while US gold futures for December delivery climbed 0.3% to $3,909.70 per ounce. This recovery was largely assisted by a drop in crude oil prices, which helped calm rising inflation worries.

Precious metals found relief as energy costs fell more than 3% following news that Iranian negotiators were holding discussions with Qatari mediators in Doha to seek an end to the US-Israeli conflict involving Iran. Previously, high energy expenses had driven expectations that the Federal Reserve would maintain elevated interest rates for a longer duration, creating a heavier opportunity cost for holding non-yielding bullion.

Market participants also evaluated recent remarks from a group of Federal Reserve officials who indicated support for additional interest rate hikes to address persistent inflation. These comments followed a monetary policy meeting where short-term borrowing costs were left unchanged. According to the CME’s FedWatch Tool, traders are currently estimating a 73% probability of a rate increase occurring in December.

Despite the recent bounce, analysts note that bullion faces a challenging environment in the near term. Ole Hansen, head of commodity strategy at Saxo Bank, pointed out that technical selling and liquidity concerns continue to outweigh the metal's longer-term appeal for investors. Alongside gold's movement, spot silver advanced 1.8% to $49.97 per ounce, platinum rose 0.1% to $1,432.63 per ounce, and palladium remained steady at $976.31 per ounce.

stories.title: Lahore High Court demands reports on extended detention of Imran Khan's sisters
stories.summary:
The Lahore High Court instructed the Punjab Home Department to submit official reports concerning petitions that challenge the prolonged detention of PTI founder Imran Khan’s sisters. Justice Abher Gul Khan set a deadline of 2pm for the reports during a hearing that addressed legal challenges filed by Sakeen, the daughter of Noreen Niazi, and Shahrez Khan, the son of Aleema Khan.

The three sisters—Aleema, Noreen, and Uzma Khan—were initially detained in September under the Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance of 1960. The detentions occurred as the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf party prepared for a protest march to Islamabad aimed at demanding the release of Imran Khan. Aleema was taken into custody on September 20 for a thirty-day period, while Noreen and Uzma were detained the following day for the same duration.

Petitioner's counsel Rana Mudassar Umar argued before the court that the extended detentions issued by the Lahore deputy commissioner after the initial thirty-day limit expired were unlawful. He also stated that the detained women were denied permission to meet with their legal counsel and family members. Additionally, PTI Secretary General Advocate Salman Akram Raja requested judicial leniency for Aleema's driver, who was also taken into custody, noting the severe distress experienced by his family.

During the proceedings, it was noted that Noreen Niazi's health had deteriorated at Kot Lakhpat Jail, prompting prison doctors to transfer her to the Punjab Institute of Cardiology. Although Rana Sanaullah, an adviser to the prime minister on political affairs, later reported to the Senate that Noreen had recovered following treatment, the court previously directed her lawyer to file a separate application regarding her medical care and family visits.

stories.title: Euronext CEO Stéphane Boujnah to depart in 2027 with David Knibbe nominated as successor
stories.summary:
Euronext announced that Stéphane Boujnah will leave his roles as chief executive officer and chairman of the board in May 2027. Boujnah has been at the helm of the company since 2015, guiding its operations through various strategic developments over more than a decade of leadership.

To succeed Boujnah, the company intends to nominate David Knibbe, who currently serves as the chief executive officer of NN Group. The planned leadership transition will mark a significant change for the pan-European market infrastructure operator upon Boujnah's departure.

The appointment of David Knibbe as the incoming chief executive officer and chairman is not yet finalized. The transition remains subject to both regulatory approval and the consent of Euronext shareholders before taking effect ahead of the scheduled handover in May 2027.

stories.title: ایل پی جی مافیا بے لگام، سرکاری نرخوں پر فراہمی تاحال ناممکن
stories.summary:
پاکستان بھر میں مائع گیس یعنی ایل پی جی کی سرکاری نرخوں پر دستیابی تاحال ممکن نہیں ہو سکی ہے۔ دکانداروں کے خلاف مختلف کارروائیوں کے باوجود گیس کی قیمتوں میں کوئی کمی دیکھنے میں نہیں آئی، بلکہ صورتحال یہ ہے کہ ایل پی جی پمپس ضبط کیے جانے کے اضافی اخراجات بھی بالآخر عام صارفین سے ہی وصول کیے جانے لگے ہیں۔

موسم کی تبدیلی اور بڑھتے ہوئے توانائی بحران کے باعث ملک میں ایل پی جی کی کھپت میں مسلسل اضافہ ہورہا ہے جس کے ساتھ ہی اس کی قیمتیں بھی آسمان کو چھو رہی ہیں۔ لاہور سمیت ملک کے تمام چھوٹے بڑے شہروں میں ایل پی جی مقررہ سرکاری نرخوں سے کہیں زیادہ داموں فروخت ہو رہی ہے۔ اوگرا کے اعداد و شمار کے مطابق ملک کی 411 ایل پی جی کمپنیوں میں سے صرف 45 کمپنیوں کے پاس مقامی پیداوار کا کوٹہ موجود ہے جبکہ 300 سے زائد دیگر کمپنیاں انہی اداروں سے گیس خرید کر آگے فروخت کرتی ہیں، جس پر قابو پانے کے لیے اوگرا کوٹہ سسٹم ختم کر کے بولی کا نظام لانے کی کوشش کر رہا ہے۔

ایل پی جی ڈسٹری بیوٹرز ایسوسی ایشن کے مرکزی رہنما رانا عبدالجبار کا کہنا ہے کہ مہنگی گیس فروخت کرنے کے اصل ذمہ دار عام دکاندار نہیں بلکہ پلانٹس ہیں۔ ان کا دعویٰ ہے کہ پلانٹس سے ہی ایل پی جی ساڑھے پانچ سو روپے فی کلو مل رہی ہے تو اسے اوگرا کے نرخوں پر کیسے فروخت کیا جا سکتا ہے۔ ان کا یہ بھی کہنا ہے کہ اوگرا کا موجودہ نوٹیفکیشن درست نہیں کیونکہ اس میں نقل و حمل کے اخراجات 2016 کے نرخوں کے مطابق شامل ہیں جبکہ گذشتہ 10 برسوں میں اخراجات بہت بڑھ چکے ہیں۔ ایسوسی ایشن نے حکومت کو قیمتوں کے تعین کا نیا شیڈول پیش کیا ہے اور توقع ہے کہ آئندہ ماہ قیمتیں 400 سے 450 روپے فی کلو مقرر ہو جائیں گی۔

دوسری جانب دکانداروں کا کہنا ہے کہ پیرا فورس اور دیگر ادارے آ کر ان کے پمپس اٹھا کر لے جاتے ہیں جن کی مالیت 70 سے 75 ہزار روپے تک ہوتی ہے۔ اس نقصان کا بوجھ بھی آخر کار صارفین پر ہی ڈالا جاتا ہے۔ دکانداروں نے سوال اٹھایا ہے کہ اصل مافیا اور کمپنیوں کے خلاف کارروائی کرنے کے بجائے صرف چھوٹے دکانداروں کو ہی کیوں نشانہ بنایا جا رہا ہے۔

stories.title: Former Alcaraz coach Juan Carlos Ferrero joins American player Ben Shelton for 2027 season
stories.summary:
Juan Carlos Ferrero, a former world number one tennis player who ended his partnership with Carlos Alcaraz late last year, is set to join American player Ben Shelton’s coaching staff ahead of the 2027 season. Ferrero previously guided Alcaraz to victories in six major titles during their time together.

In his new role, Ferrero will work alongside Shelton's father, Bryan, as part of the team supporting the 24-year-old athlete. Expressing enthusiasm for the partnership, Ferrero highlighted Shelton's extraordinary talent, power, and character as they embark on this upcoming chapter.

Shelton enjoyed a strong season that included tournament victories in Dallas, Munich, Stuttgart, and Montreal, culminating in a run to the US Open final. While Shelton prepares for the Paris Masters and the season-ending ATP Finals, he will begin collaborating with Ferrero during the close season.

Shelton praised his new coach, describing Ferrero as one of the great minds in the sport. He emphasized that Ferrero's extensive experience in winning at the highest level and fostering champions will serve as a valuable asset to his team moving forward.

stories.title: وزیراعظم ہاؤسنگ اسکیم کے قرض داروں کی تعداد میں اضافہ
stories.summary:
اسلام آباد میں وزیراعظم شہباز شریف کی زیر صدارت ترجیحی شعبوں کو آسان قرضوں کی فراہمی کے امور پر ایک اہم جائزہ اجلاس منعقد ہوا۔ اجلاس کے دوران وزیراعظم کو بریفنگ دی گئی کہ وزیراعظم اپنا گھر ہاؤسنگ اسکیم سے مستفید ہونے والے قرض داروں کی مجموعی تعداد بڑھ کر ایک لاکھ 87 ہزار 317 تک پہنچ چکی ہے۔ اس اجلاس میں وفاقی وزرا، گورنر اسٹیٹ بینک جمیل احمد، کمرشل بینکوں کے سربراہان اور دیگر اعلیٰ حکام نے شرکت کی۔

اجلاس میں بتایا گیا کہ اسٹیٹ بینک ترجیحی شعبوں میں قرضوں کے فروغ کے لیے ضوابط کی بہتری، رسک کی شراکت اور ڈیجیٹل سہولیات جیسے تین بنیادی ستونوں پر کام کر رہا ہے۔ 23 اکتوبر 2026 تک وزیراعظم اپنا گھر پروگرام کے تحت 511 ارب روپے مالیت کے 86 ہزار 899 قرضے منظور کیے جا چکے ہیں جبکہ 15 ہزار 584 درخواست گزاروں میں 91 ارب روپے جاری ہو چکے ہیں۔ اس طرح ہاؤسنگ فنانس کا مجموعی حجم 455 ارب روپے ہو چکا ہے۔

اسی طرح زرعی شعبے میں قرضوں کا حجم 1329 ارب روپے تک جا پہنچا ہے جس سے مستفید ہونے والے افراد کی تعداد تقریبا 35 لاکھ ہو گئی ہے۔ چھوٹے و درمیانے درجے کے کاروباری اداروں یعنی ایس ایم ایز کے شعبے میں قرضوں کا حجم 1148 ارب روپے اور اس سے مستفید کاروباری افراد کی تعداد 3 لاکھ 42 ہزار 458 ہو گئی ہے۔ مالی سال 2027 کے اختتام تک زراعت اور ایس ایم ایز کے شعبوں میں قرضوں کا حجم 1,500 ارب روپے تک لے جانے کا ہداف مقرر کیا گیا ہے۔

وزیراعظم نے اجلاس سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے شاندار کارکردگی کا مظاہرہ کرنے والے بینکوں کی تعریف کی اور ہدایت کی کہ سست روی کا مظاہرہ کرنے والے بینکوں کے ساتھ کوئی رعایت نہ برتی جائے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ زراعت، ہاؤسنگ اور ایس ایم ایز کی ترقی سے معیشت مضبوط ہوگی اور نوجوانوں کو روزگار ملے گا لہٰذا تمام ادارے باہمی تعاون کو مزید فروغ دیں۔

stories.title: Pakistan Launches Week-Long Anti-Polio Campaign Targeting 20.4 Million Children
stories.summary:
Pakistan has initiated a week-long sub-national anti-polio campaign across 97 selected districts nationwide. The drive aims to immunize 20.4 million children, deploying approximately 200,000 frontline workers for door-to-door visits to administer polio drops. The campaign is being launched simultaneously alongside Afghanistan.

Ayesha Raza Farooq, the Prime Minister’s Focal Person for Polio Eradication, urged parents and caregivers to ensure that all children under the age of five receive the vaccine during the drive, which runs from November 2 to November 8. She emphasized that vaccination is critical for protecting children against the dangerous disease, which has no cure and can result in lifelong paralysis.

The nationwide effort follows the recent confirmation of Pakistan's eighth polio case of 2026, involving a 13-month-old girl from the Khyber district in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Authorities noted that six of the country's eight cases this year have originated in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Positive environmental samples in the Peshawar block have also highlighted ongoing virus transmission risks.

So far in 2026, Pakistan has conducted four large-scale vaccination campaigns, reaching over 45 million children, alongside targeted interventions in high-risk areas. Although the country has reduced polio cases by 99.8 percent since the early 1990s, the National Emergency Operations Centre continues to stress community cooperation and routine immunizations to achieve complete eradication.

stories.title: Asian Factory Activity Growth Slows Amid Fading AI Boom and Price Pressures
stories.summary:
Factory activity across Asia continued to expand in October, but growth decelerated among major chip exporters. Private surveys released on Monday indicate that the AI boom may be losing momentum as markets begin questioning the sector's profitability and regional economies face strain from elevated fuel and food prices driven by the prolonged Middle East conflict.

Manufacturing activity slowed in China, Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan. China's RatingDog General Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) fell to 52.0 in October from 52.1 in September, while Japan's PMI eased to 53.3 and South Korea's fell to 51.3. Conversely, manufacturing activity accelerated in Vietnam, Indonesia, and Malaysia.

Economists noted that strong demand for chips and artificial intelligence goods had previously masked soft spots in the global economy. However, high inflation is now dampening Asian consumption, and intensifying price competition from China is putting pressure on rival exporters like Japan and South Korea.

Looking ahead, the International Monetary Fund has warned of heightened risks from energy shocks and a potential correction in the AI sector. The IMF projects Asia's economic growth to moderate to 4.8 percent in 2026 and 4.4 percent in 2027, following a 5.0 percent expansion in 2025.

stories.title: Lahore Air Quality Reaches Hazardous Levels as AQI Crosses 530
stories.summary:
Air pollution in Lahore worsened significantly, with the Air Quality Index (AQI) surpassing 530 and fine particulate matter (PM2.5) concentrations reaching 343 micrograms per cubic metre according to monitoring platform IQAir.
